name: [X-03] Guest cancels an instant booking → host sees it Cancelled @mutating
fullName: Cross-role [X-03] Guest cancels an instant booking → host sees it Cancelled @mutating
description:
Cross-role flows (guest ⇄ host), on one simulator: the test signs out of
one account and into the other inside the app, as a person sharing a phone
would. Every booking made here is cancelled; every calendar change restored.
